precedences.comment: Art. 406.7 lists the onward journey and accommodation twice: once without a limit, once up to 2000 CHF. We apply the limit of 2000 CHF: an item without a limit would make the limited item useless.

Art. 202.3 c covers damage as a direct consequence of high water and floods; Art. 204.1 excludes damage due to the operation of the vehicle. The document does not say where a vehicle that is driven into water belongs. We read it as damage due to operation, as the usual practice does: the water did not come to the vehicle, the driver drove into it.
Art. 202.2: if the option is agreed, Zurich does not reduce collision benefits for gross negligence.
Art. 301.3 says that this insurance applies worldwide, for up to six weeks after leaving the territory.

Art. 3 says that roadside assistance is valid only in Switzerland and Liechtenstein; Art. 406 extends roadside assistance Europe to Europe as set out in Art. 3. We read the sentence of Art. 3 as about roadside assistance CH/FL.
Art. 202.3 f covers punctured tyres; Art. 204.1 excludes damage only to the tyres. The document does not say which one wins. We read the closed list of vandalism as the specific rule, so it wins.

obligations.label: Tell Zurich at once
obligations.action: Phone 0800 80 80 80 (from abroad +41 44 628 98 98), or write. For legal protection, tell Orion.
obligations.consequence: If you break an obligation by your fault, Zurich can refuse the benefits (Art. 12).

obligations.label: Tell the police
obligations.action: The police must know about bodily injury, theft, and damage caused by animals. For animals, the gamekeeper is also possible.

obligations.label: Phone Zurich before you get help on the road
obligations.action: Let Zurich organise the roadside help, the towing and the onward journey.
obligations.consequence: Zurich does not pay for help that it did not organise or agree to.

obligations.label: Roadside assistance is not in your policy
obligations.action: Call a breakdown service; you pay its costs. If an accident or another insured event damaged the vehicle, the accidental damage insurance pays the recovery and the towing to the nearest suitable garage.

obligations.label: Use Help Point PLUS
obligations.action: Report the damage by phone or at a help point, and have the repair done at the garage that Zurich specifies.
obligations.consequence: If you do not, you pay 500 CHF more deductible.

obligations.label: Let Zurich inspect the vehicle before the repair
obligations.action: Do not repair the vehicle before Zurich has had the opportunity to inspect it.
obligations.consequence: Otherwise Zurich can reduce the benefit or pay nothing.

obligations.label: Do not accept or pay the claims of the other party
obligations.action: Zurich negotiates with the injured party, and its settlement binds you. Give the claim to Zurich.

obligations.label: Know the 30 days after a theft
obligations.action: If the vehicle is found within 30 days after Zurich receives the notice, Zurich pays the repair. If not, it is a total loss.

obligations.label: File criminal charges if Zurich asks
obligations.action: Zurich can ask you to file criminal charges.

obligations.label: Report the legal case to Orion before you engage a lawyer
obligations.action: Orion decides the procedure and agrees to the lawyer. Report it at the latest 6 months after the end of the contract.
obligations.consequence: Costs of a lawyer that you engaged before you reported the case: at most 500 CHF.

obligations.label: Legal protection is not in your policy
obligations.action: You pay a lawyer to claim damages from another person. If another person claims damages from you, give the claim to Zurich: the liability insurance defends you against unjustified claims.

obligations.label: Get a medical certificate
obligations.action: The daily allowance needs a medical certificate. Medical expenses are paid for 5 years after the accident.

obligations.label: Help with the investigation
obligations.action: Give Zurich the documents, the information and the powers of attorney that it needs.

obligations.label: Check the territory
obligations.action: The insurance covers Europe and the countries around the Mediterranean, not Belarus, Moldova, Ukraine, Russia, Georgia, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Kazakhstan, Egypt, Algeria, Lebanon, Libya or Syria.

deadlines.label: Last day to give notice of termination
deadlines.meaning: Your notice must reach Zurich by this day. Otherwise the contract renews for one year.

deadlines.label: Last day for Zurich to tell you about a new premium
deadlines.meaning: A change of premium or conditions for the next insurance year must reach you by this day.

deadlines.label: Last day to cancel after a change of premium
deadlines.meaning: If Zurich raised the premium or changed the conditions, your cancellation must reach Zurich by the last day of the insurance year.

deadlines.label: Last day to report a legal case
deadlines.meaning: Legal cases reported later are not covered.

deadlines.label: First reduction of the deductible, and the no-claims bonus
deadlines.meaning: After 3 full years without liability or collision benefits: the deductible goes down by 500 CHF, and the bonus is paid if agreed.

deadlines.label: Second reduction of the deductible
deadlines.meaning: After 3 more years without claims: 500 CHF less again, but not below 0.

deadlines.label: End of the accident benefits
deadlines.meaning: Medical expenses, the daily allowances (at most 730 days) and the degree of disability: within 5 years of the accident.

deadlines.label: Last day to terminate after a claim
deadlines.meaning: Both sides can terminate the contract until this day. The cover then ends 14 days after the notice.

deadlines.label: A stolen vehicle becomes a total loss
deadlines.meaning: If the vehicle is not found by this day, Zurich pays a total loss. If it is found before, Zurich pays the repair.

deadlines.label: Last day to pay back the deductible
deadlines.meaning: If you do not pay, Zurich sends a reminder with 14 more days. After that the contract ends.

deadlines.label: Last day to take back the licence plates
deadlines.meaning: The insurance is suspended until then. If the plates stay deposited longer, the contract ends.

deadlines.label: End of the provisional accidental damage cover
deadlines.meaning: A proof of insurance gives provisional cover for accidental damage, accident and roadside assistance for at most four weeks, until the policy arrives.

articles.title: Contractual basis
articles.summary: The policy, these conditions and the Swiss law on insurance contracts (LIC) apply. Commercial passenger transport, rental to self-drive customers and driving school use are insured only if the policy says so.

articles.title: Period of coverage
articles.summary: Cover starts on the date in the policy. A proof of insurance gives provisional cover for up to four weeks. Without notice three months before the end, the contract renews for one year.

articles.title: Territorial scope
articles.summary: Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Europe and the countries around the Mediterranean, except 13 listed countries. Roadside assistance only in Switzerland and Liechtenstein. Cover ends if the owner moves abroad.

articles.title: Payment of premiums and adjustment of contract
articles.summary: How the premium is set, paid, changed and refunded.

articles.title: Premium basics
articles.summary: The premium depends on the scope and on the facts about the insured persons and the vehicle. Tell Zurich at once when these facts change.

articles.title: Premium adjustments
articles.summary: A loss does not change the premium. The premium for declared young drivers goes down at each due date until age 25.

articles.title: Installment payment
articles.summary: Payment in installments costs a surcharge.

articles.title: Balances
articles.summary: Nobody claims a balance below 5 CHF.

articles.title: Contract amendments by Zurich
articles.summary: Zurich can change premiums and conditions from the next insurance year. It tells you at least 25 days before the end of the year; you can cancel by the last day of the year.

articles.title: Consequences of default
articles.summary: If you do not pay, you pay the reminder costs, the interest and the costs of a licence plate revocation.

articles.title: Premium reimbursement
articles.summary: Zurich refunds the premium of the unused period, except after a paid total loss or when you terminate in the first year after a partial loss.

articles.title: No-claims bonus
articles.summary: If agreed, a bonus after 3 full insurance years without liability or collision benefits. An insurance year counts if it lasts at least 11 months.

articles.title: Deductibles
articles.summary: You pay the agreed deductible for each loss that Zurich pays.

articles.title: Reduction of the deductible
articles.summary: The liability and collision deductibles go down by 500 CHF after 3 claim-free insurance years, and by 500 CHF again after 3 more. Not below 0. An insurance year counts if it lasts at least eleven months.

articles.title: Recovery of the deductible
articles.summary: If Zurich paid the injured party directly, you pay back the deductible within four weeks; after a reminder, 14 more days, or the contract ends.

articles.title: Removal of the deductible
articles.summary: No liability deductible for strict liability without fault, joy rides you could not prevent, events without consequences, or losses you pay back within 30 days.

articles.title: Towing vehicle and trailer
articles.summary: One deductible, the higher one, when the towing vehicle and the trailer are damaged in the same event.

articles.title: Items transported and protective clothing
articles.summary: No deductible for items carried and for protective clothing.

articles.title: Interchangeable license plates
articles.summary: Cover for the vehicle that has the plates, and for the other one only off public roads.

articles.title: Replacement vehicles
articles.summary: A replacement vehicle approved by the authority with your plates is covered. Accidental damage covers it if it is equivalent, except collision.

articles.title: Deposit of license plates
articles.summary: Deposited plates suspend the insurance. For up to 12 months, liability and collision apply off public roads only. After 12 months the contract ends.

articles.title: Obligations in the event of a claim
Obligation to notify
articles.summary: Tell Zurich or Orion at once and help with the investigation. Tell the police about bodily injury, theft and damage by animals.

articles.title: Liability insurance
articles.summary: Zurich negotiates with the injured party. You must not accept or pay their claims.

articles.title: Accidental damage insurance
articles.summary: Let Zurich inspect the vehicle before and after repairs. With Help Point PLUS, report by phone or at a help point and repair at the garage that Zurich specifies, or pay 500 CHF more deductible.

articles.title: Roadside assistance
articles.summary: Phone Zurich at once. Zurich does not pay for help that it did not organise.

articles.title: Termination in the event of a loss
articles.summary: After a paid loss, both sides can terminate within 14 days. Cover ends 14 days after the notice.

articles.title: Consequences of breach of contract
articles.summary: If an insured person does not obey the obligations, no benefits are paid, unless nobody is at fault.

articles.title: Assignment of claims
articles.summary: Do not assign or pledge benefits before they are set, without Zurich's agreement.

articles.title: Broker compensation
articles.summary: Zurich can pay a broker who represents the policyholder.

articles.title: Place of jurisdiction
articles.summary: Zurich or Basel, or your Swiss or Liechtenstein place of residence.

articles.title: Sanctions
articles.summary: No benefits if they violate trade or economic sanctions.

articles.title: Scope of insurance
articles.summary: Claims for bodily injury and property damage from the operation of the vehicle, traffic accidents and help after accidents.

articles.title: Loss prevention costs
articles.summary: The costs to prevent an imminent insured loss.

articles.title: Gross negligence coverage
articles.summary: If agreed, Zurich does not recover money for gross negligence, except for drunk or unfit driving and flagrant speeding.

articles.title: Insured persons
articles.summary: The policyholder, the owner, and the persons the owner is responsible for.

articles.title: Insurance benefits
articles.summary: Up to 100 million CHF per event; 5 million CHF for damage by fire, explosion or nuclear energy.

articles.title: Property damage
articles.summary: Damage to the owner's property, to the vehicle and to the items it carries.

articles.title: Rights of recovery
articles.summary: The exclusions of Art. 104.3 to 104.6 do not apply to the injured party: Zurich pays, then recovers the money from the insured.

articles.title: Vehicle
articles.summary: The declared vehicle, with spare parts, equipment and accessories.

articles.title: Equipment and accessories
articles.summary: Extras bought at extra charge are insured up to 10% of the catalogue price.

articles.title: Collision
articles.summary: Damage from a sudden, violent, external cause: impact, collision, rollover, falling, sinking; also when it is a consequence of breakage or wear.

articles.title: Coverage for gross negligence
articles.summary: If agreed, Zurich does not reduce collision benefits for gross negligence. Under the influence of alcohol, it reduces them by the degree of fault.

articles.title: Theft
articles.summary: Theft, use without permission and robbery, and their attempts. Use by a person of the household is not theft. Closed list.

articles.title: Fire
articles.summary: Fire, explosion, lightning, short circuit and extinguishing. Not singeing, not an internal defect of electronics.

articles.title: Natural hazards
articles.summary: Storm of at least 75 km/h, hail, flood, rockslide, landslide, avalanche, snow pressure, falling ice, falling aircraft. All other natural hazards are excluded.

articles.title: Glass
articles.summary: Windscreen, side, roof and rear windows. For motorcycles, the scope of Glass PLUS. Nothing if the repair reaches the replacement value. Closed list.

articles.title: Animals
articles.summary: Collision with an animal. Damage from swerving to avoid an animal is collision damage (Art. 202.1).

articles.title: Vandalism
articles.summary: Breaking off parts, painting or spraying (not scratching), puncturing tyres, slashing the roof, substances in the fuel tank. Closed list.

articles.title: Glass PLUS
articles.summary: All vehicle parts of glass, and the light bulbs destroyed with them.

articles.title: Martens
articles.summary: Damage and consequential damage from martens or rodents.

articles.title: Parking damage
articles.summary: Damage by unknown vehicles or persons while parked. Two events per calendar year, 1000 CHF per event. With Parking damage PLUS, this limit does not apply.

articles.title: Items transported in the vehicle
articles.summary: Items damaged with the vehicle, or stolen by breaking into the locked vehicle. Electronics only in cars, vans and motorcycles. Not cash, cards, jewellery, data, animals.

articles.title: Protective clothing (for motorcycles)
articles.summary: Helmets, suits, protectors, boots and gloves: damage in an accident (not only optical) and theft from a locked container or with a helmet lock.

articles.title: Partial loss
articles.summary: Zurich pays the reasonable costs of repair, with the condition and the age of the vehicle in mind. Without repair, the costs without VAT.

articles.title: Total loss
articles.summary: Total loss: repair costs of at least 65% of the table value in the first two years, or of the replacement value later, or a stolen vehicle not found within 30 days. The table gives the share of the catalogue price by year of service.

articles.title: Costs
articles.summary: Recovery and towing to the nearest garage, return transport to Switzerland, customs duty.

articles.title: Indemnity in the event of the theft of the vehicle
articles.summary: A stolen vehicle found within 30 days: Zurich pays the repair.

articles.title: Items being transported and protective clothing
articles.summary: The value of an equivalent item; for clothing older than two years, 75% of the price. Up to the sum insured.

articles.title: Motorized mobile homes and campers/trailers
articles.summary: Full repair costs only with an invoice; without repair, the loss in value.

articles.title: Reduction of benefits
articles.summary: Zurich can reduce or refuse benefits as the law on insurance contracts allows, for example for gross negligence or intent.

articles.title: Damage due to vehicle operation
articles.summary: Operation, breakage, wear, wrong handling or fuel, lack of oil or coolant, damage only to tyres or batteries, damage by the load.

articles.title: Depreciation in value and loss of use
Races and similar rides
articles.summary: Races, rallies, competitions, racetracks, and requisition by the authorities.

articles.title: Illegal driving
articles.summary: A driver without the required licence or accompanying person, or with unlawful passengers, if the insured should have known.

articles.title: Unauthorized driving
articles.summary: Journeys that the law or the authorities do not permit.

articles.title: Alcohol/infringement of traffic regulations
articles.summary: Blood alcohol of 1.6 per mille or more (breath 0.80 mg/l), unfit by drugs or medication, flagrant speeding, illegal races.

articles.title: Special events of theft
articles.summary: Theft of fuel. Theft of a motorcycle kept outside, in a shared garage or unlocked room, or without an activated steering lock.

articles.title: State of emergency
articles.summary: War, revolution, earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, nuclear damage. Civil unrest unless reasonable precautions were taken.

articles.title: Insured persons under the policy
articles.summary: The persons that the policy names, for example the driver and the passengers.

articles.title: Helpers at accidents and breakdowns
articles.summary: Persons who help at an accident or a breakdown of the insured vehicle, but not professional helpers.

articles.title: Persons travelling in other people's vehicles
articles.summary: Death 30,000 CHF, disability 60,000 CHF. Worldwide, for up to six weeks after leaving the territory.

articles.title: In the event of death
articles.summary: The sum insured goes to the beneficiaries in a fixed order; plus 50% if a minor child is left.

articles.title: In the event of disability
articles.summary: A share of the sum insured by degree of disability, up to 225%. Set at the latest 5 years after the accident.

articles.title: Daily allowance
articles.summary: With a medical certificate, for up to 730 days within 5 years of the accident.

articles.title: Daily allowance in case of hospitalization
articles.summary: For up to 730 days within 5 years of the accident.

articles.title: Medical expenses
articles.summary: Necessary treatment for 5 years after the accident, after social security.

articles.title: Insured pets
articles.summary: Veterinary treatment of pets in the car, up to 5000 CHF per event.

articles.title: Exclusions
articles.summary: Joyriding, and the exclusions of Art. 204.3 to 204.9 except 204.7.

articles.title: Insured vehicles
articles.summary: Vehicles up to 3500 kg and their trailers.

articles.title: Insured events
articles.summary: A breakdown or accidental damage that stops the vehicle.

articles.title: Insurance benefits
articles.summary: Roadside assistance CH/FL or Europe, as agreed.

articles.title: Limitation of benefits for roadside assistance CH/FL
articles.summary: 1000 CHF in total for all persons per event.

articles.title: Roadside assistance Europe
articles.summary: Roadside assistance within Europe, as set out in Art. 3.

articles.title: Loss of keys
articles.summary: Lists the onward journey by public transport and accommodation twice: once without a limit, once up to 2000 CHF.

articles.title: Repatriation of the vehicle from abroad
Customs duty / scrapping fees for a vehicle abroad
Exclusions
articles.summary: Third-party recovery claims, and the exclusions of Art. 204.3 to 204.9 except 204.7.

articles.title: Scope of insurance
articles.summary: Damages, criminal charges, defence, licence confiscation, social and other insurance law, medical law, vehicle contracts, garage rental.

articles.title: Law of damages
articles.summary: Claims for damages against other persons for damage to property or injury in a traffic accident.

articles.title: Defense
articles.summary: Defence in criminal or administrative proceedings after a traffic accident or a violation of traffic rules.

articles.title: Vehicle contract law
articles.summary: Disputes about the purchase, rental, loan, leasing, deposit or repair of the insured vehicle.

articles.title: Period of coverage and insured event
articles.summary: Cases that arise during the contract. No cover for cases reported more than 6 months after the end of the contract.

articles.title: Insurance benefits
articles.summary: Up to 500,000 CHF per legal case. Not fines, nor damages.

articles.title: Uninsured legal disputes
articles.summary: Exclusions that take precedence over Art. 502.

articles.title: Processing of cases
articles.summary: Orion decides the procedure. A lawyer engaged before you report the case: at most 500 CHF.
